finalText:
I have a clear diagnosis. Here is the summary:

---

## Diagnosis: Pod `c021-config` stuck — CreateContainerConfigError

### Root Cause
The `trainer` container references a ConfigMap named **`missing-model-config`** (key `bucket`) for environment variable `MODEL_BUCKET`, with `Optional: false`. This ConfigMap **does not exist** in the namespace. Kubernetes cannot create the container until the referenced ConfigMap is available, so the container remains in `Waiting` state with reason **`CreateContainerConfigError`**.

### Evidence
| Observation | Detail |
|---|---|
| Pod Status | `Pending` |
| Container State | `Waiting` / `CreateContainerConfigError` |
| Environment Variable | `MODEL_BUCKET` ← ConfigMap `missing-model-config` key `bucket` (Optional: false) |
| ConfigMap lookup | `configmaps "missing-model-config" not found` |
| Namespace ConfigMaps | Only `kube-root-ca.crt` (auto-created default) — no application ConfigMaps exist |
| Node scheduling | Pod is already scheduled on `cpu-10-208-55-85` and image `busybox:1.36` is pulled — the block is purely at container creation time |

### Impact / Scope
- Single pod (`c021-config`) in namespace `siclaw-eval-yye-20260602`.
- The pod has been stuck for ~2 days (evidenced by `x14125` kubelet Pull events over `2d3h`), retrying container creation on each sync cycle.

### Confidence
**High** — the missing ConfigMap is the sole blocker. All other pod conditions (scheduled, initialized, image pulled) are healthy.

### Remediation
Create the missing ConfigMap in the namespace with the required key:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: missing-model-config
  namespace: siclaw-eval-yye-20260602
data:
  bucket: "<actual-model-bucket-value>"
```

Replace `<actual-model-bucket-value>` with the correct model bucket path. Once applied, the pod will automatically transition to Running (no restart needed — kubelet will retry container creation on the next sync).

## Diagnosis: Pod `c021-config` stuck — CreateContainerConfigError

### Root Cause
The `trainer` container references a ConfigMap named **`missing-model-config`** (key `bucket`) for environment variable `MODEL_BUCKET`, with `Optional: false`. This ConfigMap **does not exist** in the namespace. Kubernetes cannot create the container until the referenced ConfigMap is available, so the container remains in `Waiting` state with reason **`CreateContainerConfigError`**.

### Evidence
| Observation | Detail |
|---|---|
| Pod Status | `Pending` |
| Container State | `Waiting` / `CreateContainerConfigError` |
| Environment Variable | `MODEL_BUCKET` ← ConfigMap `missing-model-config` key `bucket` (Optional: false) |
| ConfigMap lookup | `configmaps "missing-model-config" not found` |
| Namespace ConfigMaps | Only `kube-root-ca.crt` (auto-created default) — no application ConfigMaps exist |
| Node scheduling | Pod is already scheduled on `cpu-10-208-55-85` and image `busybox:1.36` is pulled — the block is purely at container creation time |

### Impact / Scope
- Single pod (`c021-config`) in namespace `siclaw-eval-yye-20260602`.
- The pod has been stuck for ~2 days (evidenced by `x14125` kubelet Pull events over `2d3h`), retrying container creation on each sync cycle.

### Confidence
**High** — the missing ConfigMap is the sole blocker. All other pod conditions (scheduled, initialized, image pulled) are healthy.

### Remediation
Create the missing ConfigMap in the namespace with the required key:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: missing-model-config
  namespace: siclaw-eval-yye-20260602
data:
  bucket: "<actual-model-bucket-value>"
```

Replace `<actual-model-bucket-value>` with the correct model bucket path. Once applied, the pod will automatically transition to Running (no restart needed — kubelet will retry container creation on the next sync).
